title: Innokin PZPPulse Replacement Pod
description: The Innokin PZPulse Empty Pod is a versatile and user-friendly refillable pod designed for use with the Innokin CoolFire PZPulse Pod Vape Kit. With a 2ml TPD-compliant capacity and a convenient top-fill design, these pods offer a hassle-free refilling experience while ensuring leak-free operation. Engineered to pair perfectly with Innokin’s PZP Max Coils, the PZPulse Pod supports three resistance options—0.2ohm, 0.4ohm, and 0.6ohm—catering to a variety of vaping styles, from direct-to-lung (DTL) to mouth-to-lung (MTL). The adjustable top airflow control allows users to fine-tune their draw for a more personalised experience. Whether you’re replacing an old pod or keeping spares on hand, the PZPulse Empty Pod delivers consistent performance and convenience for an enhanced vaping experience.
